apfs.thinningWarning.other: Time Machine has a backup destination configured, and its backup cycle thins local snapshots to roughly 24 hours. A longer retention window will not hold.

browse.folderDidNotExist.other: This folder did not exist when the snapshot was taken.

browse.folderGoneFromDisk.other: This folder is in the snapshot but no longer on disk.

browse.notCovered.other: Snapshots of the data volume do not cover this location.

cli.agentsNote.other: The scheduled task and the bulk-deletion watcher are run by launchd as --take-snapshot and --watch. Install both from the window.

cli.commandFailed.other: {{.Command}} failed; the state before it is in snapshot {{.Name}}

cli.configExists.other: {{.Path}} already exists; edit it, or delete it first to start again

cli.configMissing.other: {{.Path}} does not exist, so the defaults are in use.

cli.configWriteHint.other: Write them there to start editing: snapshotter config --write

cli.desc.config.other: show, read or change the settings

cli.desc.list.other: list the snapshots of the data volume, newest first

cli.desc.run.other: take a snapshot, then run a command

cli.desc.status.other: say whether this Mac has usable restore points

cli.desc.version.other: print the version of this build

cli.fixFileFirst.other: fix the file before setting anything

cli.noSnapshots.other: No snapshots. Nothing can be rolled back to.

cli.noSnapshotsShort.other: No snapshots — nothing to roll back to.

cli.notAConfigCommand.other: {{.Name}} is not a config command (try: keys, get, set)

cli.runNoRestorePoint.other: refusing to run without a restore point

cli.setNeedsPair.other: set needs a key and a value

cli.tagline.other: Browse, compare and schedule APFS local snapshots.

diff.inNeitherVersion.one: This file is in neither version.
diff.inNeitherVersion.other: This file is in neither version.

diff.looksBinary.one: This looks like a binary file, so there are no lines to compare.
diff.looksBinary.other: This looks like a binary file, so there are no lines to compare.

diff.tooLargeForLines.one: Too large to compare line by line.
diff.tooLargeForLines.other: Too large to compare line by line.

mount.closing.one: Snapshotter is closing {{.What}}. Only an administrator may detach a filesystem.
mount.closing.other: Snapshotter is closing {{.What}}. Only an administrator may detach a filesystem.

mount.opening.one: Snapshotter is opening {{.What}} so you can browse its files. It is attached read-only, so nothing inside can be changed — but only an administrator may attach a filesystem.
mount.opening.other: Snapshotter is opening {{.What}} so you can browse their files. They are attached read-only, so nothing inside can be changed — but only an administrator may attach a filesystem.

notify.scheduleRestored.body.other: Something had removed {{.what}}, most likely an upgrade. It is running again.

notify.tookSnapshotAt.other: Took a snapshot at {{.When}}. Whatever is still on disk can be restored.

notify.what.both.other: the schedule and the bulk-deletion watcher

schedule.noneInstalled.other: No schedule installed. Nothing is taking snapshots automatically.

schedule.onePerPeriod.other: Only one snapshot is kept per period. Any others taken in the same period — including one taken automatically when files start disappearing — are removed, and the earliest is the one kept, because it holds the most of what was there.

schedule.taskNotWrittenYet.other: The scheduled task has not written anything yet.

schedule.tripwireNotWrittenYet.other: The bulk-deletion watcher has not written anything yet.

search.nothingOpen.one: No snapshot is open, so nothing was searched. Open the {{.Count}} snapshot to search inside it.
search.nothingOpen.other: No snapshot is open, so nothing was searched. Open one of the {{.Count}} snapshots to search inside them.

search.someNotOpen.one: {{.Count}} snapshot was not searched because it is not open, so this is not the whole history.
search.someNotOpen.other: {{.Count}} snapshots were not searched because they are not open, so this is not the whole history.

search.stoppedAtLimit.other: Stopped early at the match limit — narrow the search to see the rest.

search.stoppedEarly.one: A snapshot covers the whole volume, so this stopped before reading all of it. Search inside a folder — your home directory, say — to cover it properly.
search.stoppedEarly.other: A snapshot covers the whole volume, so this stopped before reading all of it. Search inside a folder — your home directory, say — to cover it properly.

status.conflict.detail.other: {{.Agent}} looks like it takes local snapshots too. Two agents double the rate and apply two retention windows to one shared set. Install one, not both.

status.conflict.title.other: Another agent is also taking snapshots

status.fdaWarning.other: Granting Full Disk Access to this application may not be enough on its own: the scheduled task runs as a separate program and needs it too.

status.headline.coveredWithFindings.one: {{.Snapshots}}, {{.Cover}} of cover — {{.Count}} thing to look at
status.headline.coveredWithFindings.other: {{.Snapshots}}, {{.Cover}} of cover — {{.Count}} things to look at

status.headline.nothingTakingMore.one: {{.Count}} snapshot, but nothing is taking more
status.headline.nothingTakingMore.other: {{.Count}} snapshots, but nothing is taking more

status.lowSpace.detail.other: {{.Percent}} of the volume is free. Snapshots are purgeable: under space pressure macOS reclaims the oldest rather than failing a write, whatever retention is set. Freeing space is what keeps them.

status.lowSpace.title.other: Only {{.Free}} left — old snapshots may start being dropped

status.noSchedule.detail.other: macOS only schedules local snapshots when Time Machine has a backup destination. Without one, and without this schedule, today's snapshot is the last one.

status.noSnapshots.detail.other: Nothing can be rolled back to. Taking one now costs no disk space immediately, because a snapshot only grows as the files it recorded change.

status.noSnapshotsShort.other: No snapshots — nothing to roll back to

status.noTripwire.detail.other: A schedule limits how far back you can go; it does not stop a deletion finishing. The watcher takes a snapshot as soon as something starts removing files in bulk, so the rest of that deletion stays recoverable.

status.noTripwire.title.other: Nothing is watching for bulk deletion

status.overdue.detail.other: A snapshot was due at {{.due}} and the newest is still from {{.newest}}. Check the scheduled task's log.

status.scheduleMissingBinary.detail.other: launchd still has the job and still reports it as running, but the program it names ({{.Program}}) no longer exists, so every run fails and no snapshot is taken. Installing the schedule again points it at this copy.

status.scheduleMissingBinary.title.other: The schedule points at a copy of Snapshotter that is gone

status.scheduleNotRunning.detail.other: launchd has the job on disk but has not loaded it, so no snapshot will be taken.

status.scheduleNotRunning.title.other: The schedule is installed but not running

status.simulated.detail.other: Scenario {{.Scenario}} is loaded. Every snapshot, schedule and figure on this screen was invented to drive the interface, and none of it describes this Mac.

status.simulatedMounts.detail.other: SNAPSHOTTER_FAKE_MOUNTS is set. Everything inside a snapshot is invented for development, and Replace restores are refused. Nothing shown under a snapshot is real.

status.timeMachineThins.title.other: Time Machine will thin these snapshots

status.tripwireNotRunning.detail.other: It is installed but launchd has not loaded it, so nothing is watching.

status.tripwireNotRunning.title.other: The bulk-deletion watcher is not running

tray.mode.manual.other: No schedule — snapshots only when you take one
